A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TSMCTS research work. Their complete main text, equations, five figures, six tables, and Appendices A–D support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original reinforcement-learning experiments, including learning curves, depth scaling, variance, path degeneracy, ablations, and runtime comparisons.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in Section 7 and Appendix C.

M1.justification: The importance-weight update, value aggregation, sequential halving, and training losses are retained. Algorithm 1 corrects indexing and explicitly carries ancestor identifiers forward, clarifying existing bookkeeping without establishing a changed search method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Jumanji Snake-v1 and Rubikscube-partly-scrambled-v0, plus Brax Ant, Halfcheetah, and Humanoid. No training or evaluation domain or scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding figures retain the same comparator membership, including SMC/SPO, SMCTS, TRT SMC, GumbelAZ/GumbelMCTS, PPO, and TSMCTS+TRT where applicable. The expanded appendix-ablation discussion introduces no comparator.

E3.justification: The reported protocols and Tables 1–6 are unchanged. Figure 2 still uses N=4 and T=6 for SMC variants and B=24 for MCTS; the sweeps, metrics, training settings, and evaluation procedures are retained.

E4.justification: The depth, variance, path-degeneracy, root-action-count, runtime, and component analyses are already present in v2. The ablation discussed more explicitly in v3's Section 7 matches the unchanged Figure 5 in Appendix C.

E5.justification: Both retain 95% Gaussian confidence intervals, 10 seeds for performance sweeps, 5 seeds for the root-estimator analyses, and 20 seeds for learning/runtime curves. Appendix D's 128 independent planner calls per state and seed are unchanged.

E6.justification: Figures 1–5 retain identical plotted results, including confidence bands, learning curves, variance, path degeneracy, and runtime trends. v3's more explicit descriptions of Rubikscube and the component ablation concern findings already displayed in v2.

T1.justification: Appendix A.8 revises the SMC-family runtime argument from O(T) under particle parallelism to O(NT), explicitly including resampling and normalization. This substantially changes the claimed dependence on particle count. Sections 2–3 also revise the root-policy expressions and replace the explicit O(T^Omega) variance argument. The named theorems and their appendix proofs otherwise remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and principal claims: generalized SMC policy improvement, value aggregation, sequential halving, improved empirical performance and depth scaling, and preserved parallelization advantages.

C2.justification: v3 adds the interpretation that matching DNN forward-pass budgets favors MCTS by overlooking SMC parallelism. It explicitly qualifies Rubikscube performance as matching MCTS at training completion, discusses component behavior at T=6, and adds the resampling-frequency tradeoff between variance and path degeneracy.

D1.justification: Appendix D replaces anonymized hardware placeholders with the Delft AI Cluster and V100-SXM2 32GB, A40 48GB, and A100 80GB GPUs. Algorithm 1 also makes ancestor bookkeeping explicit. These improve documentation of retained methods and experiments.

R1.justification: v3 removes the related-work discussion of alternative TD-lambda backups and the Sutton (1988) and Khandelwal et al. (2016) references. It adds the DAIC resource citation and changes some SMC citation attribution, while retaining the principal positioning against prior SMC and MCTS research.

P1.justification: There are targeted explanatory rewrites, a removed related-work paragraph, expanded experimental discussion, an acknowledgment, title hyphenation, and publication-footer updates. The overall narrative structure is retained. The added ablation discussion incorrectly references appendix Figure 2 instead of Figure 5.

P2.justification: All five figures and six tables retain their content and designs. Text reflow shifts Figures 1 and 3 vertically and moves part of the conclusion to the following page; revised equation displays and the expanded Algorithm 1 cause limited layout changes.

improvement.justification: v3 improves computational-cost accounting in Appendix A.8 and hardware disclosure in Appendix D. However, new Equation 14 asserts an exponential root-policy form without reconciling it with arbitrary greedification operators and the trajectory distribution in Equation 10. This unresolved theoretical inconsistency offsets the documentation gains enough to prevent a reliable net-quality judgment; the empirical evidence is unchanged.
